name: Aohitsugi Samatoki
source:
A former member of "Dirty Dawg".

The first lieutenant of the "Katengumi", a yakuza gang that deals with disputes within the Yokohama Division. He is a violent and hot-blooded person, but also a "big brother personality" who is well-liked by the local people and organizations. He used to oppose his younger sister, Nemu, joining the Party of Words, but now respects her beliefs and approves of her membership. He doesn’t like how the Party of Words operates, and is prepared to confront his sister head-on, even if she stands in his way.
